display.purpose: Hero headlines and the strongest brand moments.

headline.purpose: Major section headings and CTA headlines.

body.purpose: Readable product explanation and dense supporting copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, buttons, tabs, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: active-dot-glow
shadows.purpose: Timeline emphasis and active state marks.

micro.purpose: Label/value stacks and tight metadata relationships.

control.purpose: Icon/text spacing inside controls and small action groups.

row.purpose: Workspace rows, menu rows, and list-item relationships.

content.purpose: Readable message bodies and compact content blocks.

panel.purpose: Bounded settings, dashboard, approval, and panel surfaces.

stage.purpose: Major thread, modal, and stage-level separation.

motion.name: painterly-drift
motion.purpose: Slow monochrome painterly movement behind the landing page.

motion.name: painterly-pulse
motion.purpose: Soft monochrome wash pulse for the trace imagery.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Required alternative for decorative painterly motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast monochrome CTA for walkthrough and approval actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.58); border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f2f0ec 0%, #c6c4bf 100%); color: #050607; font: 700 13px/1 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fb6e8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet action for demo or secondary navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(242,240,236,0.25); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(242,240,236,0.035); color: #f2f0ec; font: 700 13px/1 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fb6e8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.html:
Trace & inspect

Inspect traces, inputs, and results to understand every decision.
components.css: .ds-panel-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(242,240,236,0.14); border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(242,240,236,0.08), rgba(242,240,236,0.035)), rgba(28,28,28,0.78); color: #f2f0ec; box-shadow: 0 32px 120px rgba(0,0,0,0.48); font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 22px/1.16 "Lora", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-panel-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: rgba(242,240,236,0.68); line-height: 1.58; }

components.name: Approval Pill
components.description: Small status mark for pending approvals.
components.css: .ds-approval-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(242,240,236,0.14); border-radius: 999px; color: rgba(242,240,236,0.68); background: rgba(242,240,236,0.055); font: 700 11px/1 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Mock Address Field
components.description: Read-only metadata field inside landing animation references.
components.css: .ds-mock-address { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(242,240,236,0.14); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(28,28,28,0.78); color: rgba(242,240,236,0.56); font: 400 11px/1.4 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Compact top navigation for the landing page.
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 34px; color: #f2f0ec; font: 700 13px/1 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-primary-nav a:hover, .ds-primary-nav a:focus-visible { color: #ffffff; outline: none; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
CodePawl's interface should feel like a dark, disciplined operating system for adaptive AI agents: legible, instrumented, and calm under pressure. The landing visual system uses deep monochrome ink surfaces, warm off-white text, restrained semantic pigments inside product state only, compact panels, and a visual-only black-and-white halftone brain rotation.

The brand is premium because it is precise, not because it is decorative. The page should show memory, reusable skills, verification, self-improvement, and safe tool use as proof that the product gives agents a working brain while keeping powerful actions bounded.
keyCharacteristics: Deep monochrome ink foundation with warm off-white neutrals and rare semantic pigment.
The landing animation is a transparent black-and-white halftone brain sequence with a smooth crossfade loop and no panel, border, glow, or runtime shader.
A purposeful radius scale: 8px for compact controls, 10px for buttons, 16px for panels, and pills only for compact status.
Outfit across normal UI text, with Lora reserved for major typography.
Atmospheric painterly wash and trace texture that never hide content.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors must explain state or risk. Do not use the status palette as decoration.

rules.name: The Quiet Color Rule
rules.body: Most surfaces stay ink-dark and warm off-white. Pigments appear as reflected light, state indicators, and rare emphasis.

rules.name: The No Costume Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for code snippets and telemetry only; it is not the default way to say "technical."

rules.name: The Split Role Rule
rules.body: Outfit carries normal UI text, labels, body copy, and compact metadata. Lora is reserved for headings, brand moments, and important titles.

rules.name: The Spacing-First Separation Rule
rules.body: Separate continuous workspace regions with gap, padding, typography, and tonal fills. Do not use HTML rule elements or top/bottom-only border rules as section breaks.

rules.name: The Purpose Spacing Rule
rules.body: Spacing follows what an element does: micro for label/value stacks, control for icon/text controls, row for lists and menus, content for readable message bodies, panel for bounded settings or dashboard groups, and stage for major thread or dialog separation. Do not reuse one padding value across user messages, system notices, agent responses, approvals, metrics, and panels when those elements carry different jobs.

dos: Do keep CodePawl dark, calm, and legible with #050607 and #090b0d as the dominant ink surfaces.
Do use semantic accents only for success, risk, info, and destructive states.
Do use the documented radius scale: 8px compact controls, 10px buttons, 16px panels, and 999px status pills.
Do use fewer cards and make each one earn its frame.
Do show approvals, traces, cost, and current run state as product proof.
Do preserve reduced-motion support for painterly wash and trace motion.
Do keep body text contrast strong; muted copy should remain readable on dark and translucent surfaces.
donts: Don't make CodePawl look like a neon cyberpunk agent dashboard.
Don't build an overloaded observability wall full of charts before the user understands the run.
Don't make the product feel like a raw terminal-first tool.
Don't promise effortless full autonomy, enterprise RPA replacement, CAPTCHA bypassing, or safety without human approval.
Don't use accent color as decoration.
Don't pair wide decorative shadows with every bordered nested item.
Don't introduce repeated tiny uppercase section eyebrows as a default scaffold.
